- **Magic Albums sees your whole library (FL-1306):** the review now lists the albums on your Albums page, including ones inside collections, albums you also use in Boards, partner albums and albums shared with you. Smart albums, albums filled automatically by a rule and albums that are only in Boards are left out.
- **Your collections stay as you arranged them (FL-1306):** albums already in a collection can have duplicates beside them merged and lost dates fixed, and they stay where they are. Partner albums, albums shared with you and collections are listed but never changed.
